name: BlobCursor-TS-TW
title: Blob Cursor
description: A round violet shape chases the mouse across a dark panel, flexing into a teardrop as it moves, with fainter copies lagging behind it.
use: A playful portfolio or marketing page wants a custom pointer with personality.
avoid: The blob slides over nearby text, and being pointer-only it does nothing for keyboard or reduced-motion users.
a11y: Purely decorative pointer movement; the trail cannot be reached from the keyboard and ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A violet disc with a small white dot at its centre glides over a near-black panel, its edges blurred into a soft cloud. When it moves it stretches into an egg shape, and dimmer copies trail it.
behaves: Each pointer move tweens three discs toward the cursor at different speeds, so the largest lags and the smallest leads. When the pointer stops they settle back into round blobs.
customise: Blob shape, fill, inner dot colour and size, trail count, sizes, opacities, shadow and blur filter are all props. There is no content to pass in.
weight: light: Three plain divs tweened by GSAP, with one SVG blur filter laid over them.
